segments.en: Welcome back, and good morning, if you're joining us from across the Asia Pacific, we're going into the open to the just under about a minute away, as you can see, we are called higher across both on-shore and off-shore markets, the stronger fixed coming through, perhaps also helping boost sentiment.
segments.zh: 欢迎回来，早上好。亚太地区的观众，开盘在即，不到一分钟。如您所见，在岸和离岸市场均高开，人民币走强可能也提振了情绪。

segments.en: and a couple of seconds we'll be getting the first of many data points, home price numbers are coming out in about, out about the open, so we'll break that to you once they do drop across our terminals.

segments.en: Yeah, it's interesting, there was a report coming up from Morgan Stanley saying that they had a survey showing the housing sentiment is actually recovering, but when it comes to a week purchased demand, that remains a drag on home prices here, so certainly there's a bit of, I guess you say sentiment is helping maybe particularly in the tier one cities as well, but certainly it's not enough to lift tier 223 at this point in terms of the data is concerned.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，摩根士丹利的一份报告显示，他们的调查表明楼市情绪正在回暖，但购房需求仍然疲软，拖累房价。可以说，情绪改善可能尤其利好一线城市，但还不足以拉动二三线城市。
